svg.title: Read mapping: a read that fits one place gets a high mapping quality, a read that matches two copies of a repeat gets mapping quality 0, and a read whose end does not match is soft-clipped
svg.text: One base differs, but no other place fits better.
It matches both copies, so the aligner can't choose.
The last bases don't match, so they're left out
of the alignment but kept in the file.
